$comment: AUTHORED. The only hand-edited file in design/tokens/. tokens.json, tokens.css, tokens.ts and contrast.md are all generated from this file by `npm run build:tokens`; `npm run check:tokens` fails on drift. Type is DERIVED from the numbers below, colour is CARRIED through unchanged, contrast is COMPUTED. Derivation rules and their sources: design/system/type.md and docs/03-system-design/DESIGN-CAPABILITY.md §7.1.

type.$comment: A PROPOSAL, not a migration. These are mission-control's own values re-expressed as a derivable ramp: its nine authored sizes (10 11 11.5 12 12.5 13 13.5 14 15, plus 20) collapse to a five-step UI band on integer increments and a one-step display band. No mission-control source file is touched by this; the remap is a separate design pass.

family.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
family.mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

color.$comment: CARRIED, NOT DERIVED. Twelve values, verbatim from mission-control/client/src/styles.css. Nothing here is generated and nothing here is a ramp — colour is decided in design/system/palette.md, which is unanswered. A generated palette would be a claim this repository has not earned.

contrastPairs.note: column headers, footnotes, placeholders — the lowest-contrast thing allowed to carry meaning
input text on the raised surface
secondary text on the raised surface
SURFACE PAIR — the one horizontal rule in the app. A ratio is the wrong metric for a rule; this row exists to show it is a line you can see
SURFACE PAIR — borders and rules, never text
SURFACE PAIR — hover fill, never the sole carrier of anything
SURFACE PAIR — row banding. styles.css argues at length that ΔE76 (4.82) is the right metric here and the ratio is not
